- Rolled back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — in all regions.
- Verified post-rollback: service is now **healthy** with an error rate of **0.2%**.

**Incident:**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), describing the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the need to investigate the root cause of v2.3.1 before re-attempting the release.
- The on-call engineer has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.
